regressions.source: DelegationManager.sol _cancelUnbonding: UnbondingDelegation memory entry = unbondingDelegations[msg.sender][i] (copy of the string validator to memory), keccak256(bytes(entry.validator)) == keccak256(bytes(validator))
regressions.issue: The write mem[mem[64]] = _56 is now taken as possibly overwriting mem[0], so mem[0] = sha3(caller, 1) is no longer forwarded: the storage string copy becomes a while loop with raw stor[t + sha3(mem[0])] addressing, the element reads lose their stor1[caller][s] name, a dead 't = ...' line follows the loop, and dead mem[0]/mem[32] writes reappear.
regressions.rule: A loop-carried mem[64] keeps the constant floor it has on entry (here at least 0x80) when every update adds a nonnegative amount, so a write at [mem[64], mem[64] + 32) cannot touch the scratch words 0..63: keep forwarding mem[0] and mem[32] past it.

regressions.issue: The require is no longer folded into a helper and is not recognized as a string revert either: the selector is written at '_53 + ...' and the rest at 'mem[64] + ...', which the matcher does not see as one buffer, so a one-line 'revert with ...' became five lines of raw memory. The function's final 'Unbonding delegation does not exist' revert also grew to five raw lines (it was raw in round 1 too).
regressions.rule: Same as c00144: while '_N = mem[64]' holds, mem[64] and _N name the same address; unify them before matching 'selector 0x08c379a0, 32, len, text' as revert with 'text'.

improvements: 12 ABI-encoding copy loops became copy lines (whiles 87 -> 75: getValidator 14 -> 7, unknown570467ac 8 -> 5, unknown455b8551 6 -> 4, unknowncf2753cf 2 -> 1). The staking precompile calls are named (0x800.unknown53266bbb(?) ...) with decoded string arguments (P2 5 -> 0, P6 1 -> 0). Return-data reverts and results are direct, string lengths resolve (2 * mem[128] + 1), 'if success: stop else: revert' became guards.
notes: Reviewed by structure (2308-line diff, 16 functions, some moved in the text: compared by body). Storage writes unchanged apart from SafeMath helper renames (old sub2 split out, sub3 -> sub2) and resolved string lengths. getValidator and other ABI-decoding functions now spell buffers as long constant-offset sums instead of _8/_16 variables: exact, but longer lines. The pack lists no regex pattern.
summary: Regression (medium) in unknowna4603a2e only: mem[0] is no longer forwarded past a write at mem[64], so a storage string copy is a while loop again and a require that was readable is now a raw-memory revert. Elsewhere copies became copy lines and the precompile calls are named.
